instruction: A warehouse starts with 2140 boxes. Then the stock is doubled by merging with a sister warehouse. It receives 3 deliveries of 23 boxes each. It ships 30 boxes per day for 4 days. It receives 3 deliveries of 46 boxes each. How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory.
